label: Bale v Barcelona — the sprint past Bartra
technique: solo run, low finish under the keeper
source: Real Madrid club site, anniversary of the 19th Copa del Rey: https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/club/latest-news/eight-years-since-19th-copa-del-rey
checked: 16 Apr 2014 at Mestalla, 2-1 Real Madrid; Di María opener, Bartra equaliser (~68'), Bale 85'. Coentrão found Bale on the left just inside his own half; Bale knocked it past Bartra, ran outside the touchline, then rolled it under Pinto. | Pass 2: Coentrão's ball down the left, Bale went off the pitch round Bartra, 85', 1-1 before (Bartra 65'); reports say he slotted inside Pinto's near post / under him.
note: end moved 32.5 -> 31.4 (near post, shooter's left) per reports. Left foot not stated in sources found (from memory, very likely). Run timings estimated.

label: Messi v Athletic — the Copa final solo run
checked: 30 May 2015 at Camp Nou, Barcelona won 3-1 (Messi 20' and 74', Neymar, Williams). Opener: Messi from the right flank near halfway, past several players incl. Balenziaga, switched feet past Laporte, low left-foot finish at the near post from ~10 yards. | Pass 2: 20', Camp Nou, run from the right flank near halfway, low left-foot shot inside the near post from ~10 yards (Eurosport, SI). Keeper was Iago Herrerín (SI), not Iraizoz.
note: Fixed keeper Iraizoz -> Herrerín. Athletic listed first as in the Wikipedia final article. Route estimated.

label: Messi v Real Madrid — the 92nd-minute winner
checked: 23 Apr 2017 at the Bernabéu, 3-2 Barcelona; 90+2'; Sergi Roberto's run from defence, Alba's low ball across, Messi one-touch left foot into the bottom corner past Navas; his 500th Barça goal. | Pass 2: 92', last kick, Sergi Roberto run, Alba cut-back, 3-2 at the Bernabéu.
note: Corner disputed: Sky Sports says bottom right (kept, end 36.8), Eurosport commentary says bottom left. André Gomes link pass not confirmed by search.

label: Messi v Betis — the chip that got a standing ovation
checked: 17 Mar 2019 at the Villamarín, Betis 1-4 Barcelona (Messi 18', 45', 85'; Suárez 63'; Loren 82'). Third: first-time chip over Pau López, 85'; Betis fans applauded. Puskás 2019 nominee. | Pass 2: 85', 1-3 -> 1-4, first-time chip over Pau López from the edge of the box after a one-two with Rakitić (FC Barcelona report, ESPN).
note: Fixed the one-two partner Suárez -> Rakitić. Height under the bar (endZ 1.9) and side estimated.

label: Neymar v Villarreal — the flick over his head and volley
technique: heel flick over his own head, then volley
checked: 8 Nov 2015 at Camp Nou, 3-0 (Neymar 60', 85'; Suárez 70'). From Suárez's cross Neymar heel-flicked it over his head (and Jaume Costa) and volleyed low past Areola. Puskás 2016 nominee. | Pass 2: 85', Suárez drove down the left and chipped a cross; Neymar flicked it over Jaume Costa and volleyed past Areola. FIFA: left-foot flick, right-foot volley (kept Right Foot).
note: Spot and corner estimated (low finish). One source says the flick was right-footed.

label: Yamal v Espanyol — the title-clinching curler
checked: 15 May 2025, Espanyol 0-2 Barcelona, title clinched; Yamal 53' cut in from the right, past two, left-foot curler into the corner past Joan García; Fermín 90+5'. Puskás nominee. | Pass 2: 53', 0-0 before, came in off the right flank, slid past two defenders on the edge of the box, left-foot curler into the top corner (AP, Ahram).
note: Removed the Olmo pass: no source names a provider, reports describe it as his own dribble, so the move is now two carries in from the right. Corner side inferred from left-footer cutting in from the right.

label: Bellingham v Barcelona — the long-range equaliser
checked: 28 Oct 2023 at Montjuïc, Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid; Gündoğan 6', Bellingham 68' strike from range into the upper-left corner, then the 90+2' winner. | Pass 2: 68', 1-0 -> 1-1 (Gündoğan 6'), right foot, from about 25 m (Real Madrid report).
note: Corner disputed: Reuters says upper left (kept, end 30.8), another report says top right. Build-up not confirmed; spot estimated.

label: Higuaín v Frosinone — the record 36th, an overhead kick
checked: 14 May 2016, Napoli 4-0 Frosinone (Hamšík, Higuaín 52', 62', 71'). Third: chested down with his back to goal, bicycle kick; 36th league goal, beating Nordahl's 35. | Pass 2: 71', third of his hat-trick, 3-0 -> 4-0, chest control with back to goal then overhead kick; FourFourTwo says from 20 yards, looping over the keeper.
note: Fixed keeper Leali -> Massimo Zappino (the Frosinone keeper named in reports of this match). Spot moved y 13 -> 17 per the '20 yards' report (only one source gives a distance). Passer and corner not confirmed.

label: Ronaldo v Sampdoria — the 2.56 m header
checked: 18 Dec 2019 at Marassi, Sampdoria 1-2 Juventus; Dybala 19', Caprari 35', Ronaldo just before half-time heading Alex Sandro's cross from the left, contact at ~2.56 m. | Pass 2: 45', 1-1 -> 1-2, header from Alex Sandro's cross met at 2.56 m, past Audero (Sky Italia, Daily Star).

label: Theo Hernández v Atalanta — box to box
checked: 15 May 2022 at San Siro, Milan 2-0 Atalanta (Leão 56/57', Hernández 75'). Picked up near his own box, ran the length past several, finished low into the bottom-right corner past Musso. | Pass 2: 75', 1-0 -> 2-0 (Leão first), ~95-100 m run from near his own box after a Krunić challenge, finished back across his body low into the bottom right corner (Yahoo, Sky Italia).
note: Foot not stated in any source; Left Foot kept (across the body into the bottom right from the left fits). Route estimated.

label: Kvaratskhelia v Atalanta — the dizzying solo goal
technique: dribble, finish into the roof of the net
checked: 11 Mar 2023 at the Maradona, Napoli 2-0 Atalanta (Kvaratskhelia 60', Rrahmani 77'). Anguissa won it, Osimhen released him, he beat several defenders and finished into the roof of the net past Musso. | Pass 2: 60', 0-0 -> 1-0, fed by Osimhen, slalom past three defenders into the box, right foot into the roof of the net from 12 yards (Football Italia, The Peninsula).
note: Spot moved [47,8] -> [42,8.5]: reports say 12 yards and no source says tight angle. Side of the box and corner still estimated.

label: Dimarco v Frosinone — from the halfway line
technique: first-time lob from the halfway line
checked: 12 Nov 2023 (not October) at San Siro, Inter 2-0 Frosinone. About two minutes before half-time Dimarco, on the left near halfway, hit it first time from ~56 m over Turati who was off his line; Mkhitaryan assist. Puskás nominee. | Pass 2: 43' (two minutes before half-time), 0-0 -> 1-0, first-time from near the left touchline around halfway after Mkhitaryan released him, over Turati.
note: Mkhitaryan pass named by one outlet only. Exact spot and where it dropped estimated.

label: Quagliarella v Napoli — the backheel volley
checked: 2 Sep 2018 at Marassi, Sampdoria 3-0 Napoli (Defrel 11', 32'; Quagliarella 75'). Bereszyński's cross from the right came between his legs; right-heel volley past Koulibaly and Ospina. Puskás 2019 finalist. | Pass 2: 75' (Sky Italia, Reuters), 2-0 -> 3-0 after Defrel's two, Bereszyński cross from the right, jumping backheel from about 12 yards into the top corner (FIFA).
note: endZ raised 1.0 -> 1.9 (FIFA: top corner). Which corner estimated; Reuters calls the cross low.

label: Totti v Lazio — the hooked volley, then the selfie
checked: 11 Jan 2015 derby, Roma 2-2 Lazio (Mauri, Felipe Anderson; Totti 48', 64'). Second: Holebas's cross to the far post, Totti hooked it in acrobatically past Marchetti, then the selfie. | Pass 2: 64', 1-2 -> 2-2, acrobatic hooked finish from Holebas's cross near the post (Il Post, Eurosport), then the selfie.

label: Leão v Sassuolo — Serie A's fastest goal
technique: low drive at the near post
checked: 20 Dec 2020, Sassuolo 1-2 Milan; Leão scored after 6.76 s (record). Kick-off routine: Çalhanoğlu surged forward and slipped him in; two touches near the edge of the box, shot at the near post past Consigli. | Pass 2: kick-off move, Çalhanoğlu found Leão, angled drive past Consigli after ~6 s (6.76 s Guinness), Milan won 2-1.
note: Leão on the left channel and right foot from memory. Kick-off move simplified.
